_comment: Machine-readable anchors for paper tables/figures. Ceilings and design constants are measured quantities snapshotted from production artifacts; 'published' entries are numbers from cited prior work (never ours). scripts/make_paper_tables.py is the only consumer. All top1 values are fractions in [0,1].

ceilings._comment: Per-set DraftNet ceilings: expert val split, forced picks included, deployment population. SOS is the protocol-validation reproduction (docs/eval_protocol.md section 3, eval-protocol-v1). BRO/TMT are the production per-set models' metrics.json snapshots (3 significant digits as recorded).

BRO.source: per-set model metrics.json, BRO PremierDraft latest

TMT.source: per-set model metrics.json, TMT PremierDraft latest

published._comment: Published anchors with exact provenance. 'asterisk' marks results that are not day-1-feasible (post-release information) or not comparable populations.

bertram_bro_zeroshot.label: Features+meta+image, 13-set
bertram_bro_zeroshot.asterisk: meta block = post-release 17Lands usage statistics; not day-1-feasible

urzagpt_gpt4o.label: GPT-4o zero-shot
